title: The True Cost of Cheap Food

paragraphs.en: Food in rich countries has never been cheaper. Shoppers pay less for a meal than any generation in history. Yet the real price of that bargain is paid elsewhere: in damaged soil, polluted rivers and a warming atmosphere.
paragraphs.zh: 富裕国家的食品从未如此便宜。人们为一顿饭支付的费用比历史上任何一代人都少。然而这笔便宜账的真实代价却在别处偿付：受损的土壤、被污染的河流和不断变暖的大气。

paragraphs.en: Modern farming depends on large quantities of fertilizer and pesticide. These raise yields, but they also destroy the life in the soil and poison the water that flows into streams and seas.
paragraphs.zh: 现代农业依赖大量的化肥和农药。它们提高了产量，但也破坏了土壤中的生命，毒害了流入溪流和海洋的水源。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, farming contributes a large share of global greenhouse emissions, mainly from cattle, rice fields and the cutting down of forests to create new farmland.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，农业在全球温室气体排放中占很大比重，主要来自牛、稻田以及为开垦新农田而进行的砍伐森林。

paragraphs.en: Experts argue that the answer is not to stop farming, but to farm differently. Better soil management, less waste and diets with less meat could cut emissions without leaving plates empty.
paragraphs.zh: 专家认为，解决办法不是停止耕种，而是用不同的方式耕种。更好的土壤管理、更少的浪费以及含肉更少的饮食，可以在不让餐桌空虚的情况下减少排放。

paragraphs.en: Consumers also have a role to play. Buying seasonal produce, wasting less food and supporting farms that care for the land sends a simple message: cheap is no longer enough.
paragraphs.zh: 消费者也能发挥作用。购买当季农产品、减少食物浪费、支持善待土地的农场，传递出一个简单的信息：光便宜已经不够了。

paragraphs.en: The grocery shelf is where the future of the planet is quietly decided. Paying the true cost of food may be the cheapest way to protect it.
paragraphs.zh: 食品货架正是这个星球的未来被悄然决定的地方。为食物支付真实的价格，或许正是保护它最便宜的方式。
